lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: This is the group chat for Eden.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: It's primarily used for me to assign missions.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: It's also used for everyone to report their findings to me.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Even though your stay in Eden will be brief,

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I hope that you'll do your utmost to assist us in any way possible.
Noted.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Hold up.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: We're letting this sorry sack of crap

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: intermingle with the rest of us?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Man oh man, I never thought I'd live to see the day.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Darling!

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Am I dreaming?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: What a joy it is for us to be working on the same team.
I haven't won everyone over just yet.
I'm intrigued myself.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Give it time. You passed the initial test, didn't you?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: You've already entered Eden.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: I just want to help you adjust.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: So, will we all be going on missions together?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: I think that's a swell idea.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Cecil, Johan.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Have you got any jobs for us?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Preferably something just for me and my baby.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text:
1. Resource recovery
2. Patrol of the territory
3. Obtaining plant samples

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Your choice.
I want the Counters to tag along as well.
Let's go for option 3.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: We've arranged plenty of other activities for them.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: They're getting to experience the incubator, something you can't find in the Ark.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Instead of having them tag along on one of your missions,

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: they have more than enough to keep busy.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: As for you and me, I think the third option is our best bet.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Great minds think alike!

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: That's what I was leaning towards too.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Patrolling the perimeter would take no time at all,

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: and resource recovery may take a physical toll on you.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: So Darling,

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: wait just a moment,

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: and I'll come meet you in your room.
